questions.question: [Analogue Signals & Filters] Q: Explain the purpose of a voltage follower buffer in a filter circuit.
questions.correctAnswer: A voltage follower provides high input impedance and low output impedance, preventing the filter from being loaded by the next stage.
questions.explanation: A voltage follower provides high input impedance and low output impedance, preventing the filter from being loaded by the next stage.

questions.question: [Boolean Algebra] Q: Apply De Morgan's law to (A·B)'.
[Boolean Algebra] Q: Simplify: A·Ā
questions.correctAnswer: A·Ā = 0 (complement law: a variable ANDed with its complement is always 0).
questions.explanation: A·Ā = 0 (complement law: a variable ANDed with its complement is always 0).
